notes: Complete independent second reading of scan096 only, against both witnesses and the consolidated page. All 40 inherited comparison rows, 17 mark decisions and 16 inventory entries were reviewed.

Four proposals are reported: three substantive places in changes, and one certainty-only unreadable-count revision in certainty_decisions. Exact before/after fragments for all four are applied in proposed.tex.

M0424 is withdrawn as an unsupported independent inscription, not reworded or relocated. Its candidate words were not supplied from the mathematics. The associated phantom inventory item is withdrawn, leaving 15 supported physical inventory elements.

Five existing doubtful loci remain: the two short upper-tail readings, the cancelled p-initial word, the middle parenthetical beginning/continuation, and the tiny lower abbreviation. The count of unreadable words is unknown.
The final marginal full stop is omitted because there is no independent trace, rather than being retained as an ungrounded punctuation doubt. H has no separate terminal point at this place.

The author’s body conjectures sufficiency of restrictive conditions and discusses uniqueness separately, then returns to lifting an endomorphism. The middle note questions anabelian necessity and explicitly records a G_m caveat; the lower note names Белый and stresses anabelianity for uniqueness. These are transcribed claims, not conclusions proved in this audit.

No mathematical proof, computation, re-proof or use-check was undertaken. check_events is intentionally empty. No OCR, external research, TeX compilation or other page source was used; no shared consolidated page, apparatus or progress log was edited.
